text:
Alan Chen: quick sync idea — proposing an "ephemeral witness" flow for BYOK HSM remote-unlock during migrations. Need input on RBAC changes, audit logging shape, and incident playbook. TL;DR: temporary attestor keys (witnesses) held in customer KMS, short-lived grants to ops, cryptographic attestation blob we can log but never persist private key material.
Mira Patel: quick Q — what's the precise threat model this solves vs. just doing an offline key transfer?
Alan Chen: solves the case where customer cannot export wrapped key but needs temporary operator-assisted unlock (eg. hardware migration, emergency failover). Witnesses sign an authorization assertion so we can prove operator action without holding the private material.
Priya Rao: RBAC thoughts: restrict to oncall-crypto + sec-rotation roles, require MFA and JIT time-limited elevation. Dual-approval for anything > 10 minutes. Audit entries must include both approvers.
Sam Khan: Logging: we should emit an immutable event that includes a nonce and both signatures (witness + service). Customers should get the signed attestation and we keep only the signature blob (no privkey). Proposed event fields: event_type, actor, actor_role, witness_kid, nonce, attestation_sig, request_id, system_state_hash.
Alan Chen: agree. also want to surface to customer: signed_attestation, request_id, timestamp, proof_chain. We'll push to both customer syslog endpoint (if configured) and our immutable audit S3 bucket with object-lock.
Mira Patel: Legal: any exposure concerns if we ship the signed attestation out-of-band?
Sarah (Legal): as long as the private key material never leaves the customer's KMS and we only persist signatures/metadata, export/control risk is minimal. Add explicit consent checkbox in onboarding for this flow and default retention 90 days (customer can request longer).
devops-bot: automated checklist ready — can add a flag to deployments: `--enable-ephemeral-witness` (requires config and consent).
Alan Chen: sample RBAC snippet for PR (prototype):
```
allow:
  - role: oncall-crypto
    actions: [initiate_unlock]
    constraints:
      - mfa: true
      - time_limit: 30m
approval:
  required: 2
```
Priya Rao: Also require attestation verification step in runtime: if witness sig chain doesn't verify against customer's KMS pubkeys, abort and alert SOC.
Sam Khan: Vulnerability triage notes: if an attacker compromises a witness key or the attestation path, we need: 1) immediate revocation list update, 2) forced rewrap/rotation for affected tenants, 3) notify customers + regulator timeline if applicable. We should draft a CVE-like disclosure template for customers.
Mira Patel: Incident response playbook (bones):
- Detection: attestation verification failure or suspicious unlock outside business hours.
- Containment: revoke JIT grants, add denylist for witness KID, require fresh attestation.
- Recovery: rotate wrapped keys, re-encrypt, run integrity checks.
- Postmortem + customer notification: include signed evidence and timeline.
Alan Chen: operational bits — who owns the implementation tasks? Priya take RBAC PR, Sam take logging schema + SIEM mapping, Mira own tabletop and runbook updates. I'll draft the attestation blob format.
Priya Rao: I can start the RBAC PR this week, will propose new roles + temporary grant workflow.
Sam Khan: I'll draft logging schema and a small Lambda to forward signed attestations to customers' syslog. Also add SIEM parsers.
Mira Patel: I'll schedule a 30-minute tabletop with oncall, SOC, legal next Tue.
Sarah (Legal): I'll add consent language and retention options to the onboarding checklist.
Alan Chen: +1. Also quick thought — include an HSM uptime snapshot hash in attestation so customers can correlate.
Priya Rao: noted.
Sam Khan: vuln triage: propose monthly canary verification of attestations (random unlock dry-run) to catch discrepancies early.
Mira Patel: ok tasks clear. I'll open a parent ticket in sec-infra and link PRs.
Alan Chen: thanks team :thumbsup: — tagging follow-ups: @Priya Rao, @Sam Khan, @Mira Patel, @Sarah (Legal).
devops-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2026-03-24 10:00 to check progress on PRs.
